en: Which sentence is in the passive voice?
The window was broken by the ball.
The ball broke the window.
The boy kicked the ball.
In a passive sentence, the thing the action happens to comes first, and the verb uses a form of “be”: The window was broken by the ball.
Which sentence is in the passive voice?
The cake was eaten by the children.
The children ate the cake.
The children baked a cake.
In a passive sentence, the thing the action happens to comes first, and the verb uses a form of “be”: The cake was eaten by the children.
Which sentence is in the passive voice?
The letter was written by Grandma.
Grandma wrote a letter.
Grandma posted the letter.
In a passive sentence, the thing the action happens to comes first, and the verb uses a form of “be”: The letter was written by Grandma.
Which sentence is in the passive voice?
The match was won by our team.
Our team won the match.
Our team played well.
In a passive sentence, the thing the action happens to comes first, and the verb uses a form of “be”: The match was won by our team.
Which sentence is in the passive voice?
The song was sung by the choir.
The choir sang the song.
The choir loves singing.
In a passive sentence, the thing the action happens to comes first, and the verb uses a form of “be”: The song was sung by the choir.
Which sentence is in the passive voice?
The bridge is being repaired.
Workers are repairing the bridge.
The bridge looks very old.
In a passive sentence, the thing the action happens to comes first, and the verb uses a form of “be”: The bridge is being repaired.
Which sentence is in the passive voice?
The homework has been finished.
I have finished my homework.
I am doing my homework.
In a passive sentence, the thing the action happens to comes first, and the verb uses a form of “be”: The homework has been finished.
Which sentence is in the passive voice?
The tickets were sold in an hour.
They sold the tickets in an hour.
We bought two tickets.
In a passive sentence, the thing the action happens to comes first, and the verb uses a form of “be”: The tickets were sold in an hour.
Which sentence is in the passive voice?
The mouse was chased by the cat.
The cat chased the mouse.
The mouse ran away.
In a passive sentence, the thing the action happens to comes first, and the verb uses a form of “be”: The mouse was chased by the cat.
Which sentence is in the passive voice?
The new school will be opened by the mayor.
The mayor will open the new school.
The mayor is visiting the school.
In a passive sentence, the thing the action happens to comes first, and the verb uses a form of “be”: The new school will be opened by the mayor.
Which sentence is in the active voice?
The dog buried a bone.
A bone was buried by the dog.
The bone was hidden in the garden.
In an active sentence, the doer comes first and does the action: The dog buried a bone.
Which sentence is in the active voice?
Mum painted the fence.
The fence was painted by Mum.
The fence is painted every year.
In an active sentence, the doer comes first and does the action: Mum painted the fence.
Which sentence is in the active voice?
The chef cooked the dinner.
The dinner was cooked by the chef.
The dinner has been served.
In an active sentence, the doer comes first and does the action: The chef cooked the dinner.
Which sentence is in the active voice?
Sara opened the present.
The present was opened by Sara.
The present was wrapped in red paper.
In an active sentence, the doer comes first and does the action: Sara opened the present.
Which sentence is in the active voice?
Bees make honey.
Honey is made by bees.
Honey is sold at the market.
In an active sentence, the doer comes first and does the action: Bees make honey.
What is the passive form of “The wind blew the tent away.”?
The tent was blown away by the wind.
The wind was blown away by the tent.
The tent blows the wind away.
The object moves to the front and the verb becomes passive: The tent was blown away by the wind. The meaning stays the same.
What is the passive form of “Tom feeds the rabbits.”?
The rabbits are fed by Tom.
Tom is fed by the rabbits.
The rabbits feed Tom.
The object moves to the front and the verb becomes passive: The rabbits are fed by Tom. The meaning stays the same.
What is the passive form of “The teacher marked the tests.”?
The tests were marked by the teacher.
The teacher was marked by the tests.
The tests marked the teacher.
The object moves to the front and the verb becomes passive: The tests were marked by the teacher. The meaning stays the same.
What is the passive form of “A storm damaged the roof.”?
The roof was damaged by a storm.
The storm was damaged by the roof.
The roof damaged a storm.
The object moves to the front and the verb becomes passive: The roof was damaged by a storm. The meaning stays the same.
What is the passive form of “Millions of people watch this show.”?
This show is watched by millions of people.
Millions of people are watched by this show.
This show watches millions of people.
The object moves to the front and the verb becomes passive: This show is watched by millions of people. The meaning stays the same.
Who does the action in “The ball was caught by Amy.”?
Amy
the ball
the coach
In a passive sentence the doer comes after “by”, so it is Amy.
Who does the action in “The poem was read by Leo.”?
Leo
the poem
the teacher
In a passive sentence the doer comes after “by”, so it is Leo.
Who does the action in “The flowers were watered by my sister.”?
my sister
the flowers
the gardener
In a passive sentence the doer comes after “by”, so it is my sister.
Who does the action in “The puzzle was solved by Grandad.”?
Grandad
the puzzle
Grandma
In a passive sentence the doer comes after “by”, so it is Grandad.
Which passive sentence does not say who did the action?
The vase was broken.
The vase was broken by the cat.
The vase was broken by my brother.
A passive sentence can leave out the “by …” part, so we do not know who broke the vase.
Which passive sentence does not say who did the action?
The windows were cleaned yesterday.
The windows were cleaned by Dad.
The windows were cleaned by a robot.
There is no “by …” part, so the sentence does not tell us who cleaned the windows.
Which sentence is in the passive voice?
The treasure was found by two divers.
Two divers found the treasure.
Two divers swam to the wreck.
In a passive sentence, the thing the action happens to comes first, and the verb uses a form of “be”: The treasure was found by two divers.
Which sentence is in the passive voice?
The photos are kept in a box.
I keep the photos in a box.
I took some photos.
In a passive sentence, the thing the action happens to comes first, and the verb uses a form of “be”: The photos are kept in a box.
Which sentence is in the passive voice?
The rules were explained by the coach.
The coach explained the rules.
The coach blew the whistle.
In a passive sentence, the thing the action happens to comes first, and the verb uses a form of “be”: The rules were explained by the coach.
Which sentence is in the passive voice?
The gates are locked at nine.
We lock the gates at nine.
We walk home at nine.
In a passive sentence, the thing the action happens to comes first, and the verb uses a form of “be”: The gates are locked at nine.

example.q_en: Which sentence is in the passive voice?
example.answer_en: The window was broken by the ball.

en.title: Active and passive
en.teach: Active: the doer comes first (The dog chased the ball). Passive: the thing the action happens to comes first, with a form of be (The ball was chased by the dog).
